prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: As soon as the regulatory authority (A) / will issue the official clearance certificate, (B) / the construction work will resume immediately. (C) / No Error (D)
options: As soon as the regulatory authority (A)
will issue the official clearance certificate, (B)
the construction work will resume immediately. (C)
explanation: Clauses beginning with 'as soon as' use the simple present for future reference, so 'will issue' should be 'issues'.

prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: I will contact you (A) / the moment I will receive (B) / the updated confirmation from the operations department. (C) / No Error (D)
explanation: Time clauses introduced by 'the moment' take the simple present for future reference: 'I will receive' should be 'I receive'.

prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: When I will visit my native village (A) / next month, I will definitely distribute (B) / winter blankets to the local manual laborers. (C) / No Error (D)
options: When I will visit my native village
next month, I will definitely distribute
winter blankets to the local manual laborers.
explanation: A time clause with 'when' uses the simple present for future reference, not 'will'. Part (A) should be 'When I visit my native village'.

prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: As soon as the regulatory panel will clear (A) / the safety compliance report, our company (B) / will commence the commercial production of vaccines. (C) / No Error (D)
